newsitem.title: USA: Fatal Idaho National Guard helicopter crash probed.
newsitem.headline: Fatal Idaho National Guard helicopter crash probed.

text.p: Aviation experts Friday were investigating the cause of a helicopter crash that killed two Idaho national guardsmen and seriously injured a third as they surveyed flooding in eastern Idaho.
The Idaho Army National Guard OH-58 Kiowa helicopter crashed in a field near Firth, Idaho Thursday afternoon, killing Maj. Don Baxter, 41, and Lt. Will Neal, 29, the Idaho National Guard said.
A third occupant, Chief Warrant Officer Shelby Wuthrich, 27, suffered severe back injuries and was listed in serious condition at Idaho Falls Regional Medical Center.
Baxter had recently been assigned as Task Force Commander for National Guard units helping with flood relief efforts in eastern Idaho, which has been hit by severe flooding.
He was on a reconnaissance flight to see the extent of the flooding when the helicopter crashed, Idaho National Guard spokesman Lt. Col. James Ball said.
Ball said an accident investigation team from Boise, Idaho had arrived at the crash site and was interviewing witnesses and examining wreckage. The cause of the crash was unknown, he said.
The helicopter was assigned to the 1-183 Aviation Battalion, Idaho Army National Guard, in Boise.
